title: DoorDash × Ex-Grubhub | Curated talent introductions
intro: Four DoorDash managers posted about hiring October 12–21, 2026. This shortlist combines existing Ex-GH prospects with six candidate-specific outreach leads for Sales Development, In-Store Account Executive and Merchant GTM Engineering. Profiles are opt-in; interest, office location, requisition status, role level and skills remain to be confirmed. No candidate is currently verified for Senior ML Engineer, Agentic Foundations. These are proposed introductions, not endorsements or confirmed applications.

items.note: Enterprise restaurant partner marketing, advertising, and growth experience align with co-marketing ownership. Confirm hands-on paid media and CRM execution, desired leadership scope, and active hiring status: the accessible posting lists a September expected-fill date.
